overview.cardDescription: Generate AI-powered educational content — videos, quizzes, flashcards, games and more — via a single REST endpoint.

sse.title: SSE Streaming
sse.description: Get live progress as each stage completes.

backgroundJobs.title: Background Jobs
backgroundJobs.description: Generation continues even if you close the connection.

overview.authHeaderNote: Every request must include this header. Generate keys from the API Keys tab above.

video.description: Time-synced HTML slides with narration audio & captions.

slides.description: HTML presentation deck with images, tables & diagrams.

puzzleBook.description: Crossword, word search or logic puzzles.

mapExploration.description: Clickable SVG map with region facts.

script.description: LLM generates narration script & content plan.

html.description: ✅ Recommended stop point. HTML slides synced to audio timestamps.

render.description: Full video render (slow, only needed for download/export).

generationStages.footer: The <1>target_stage</1> query parameter on <3>POST /generate</3> controls which stage to stop at. Default is <5>HTML</5>.

generateTab.cardDescription: Starts a generation job and streams real-time progress via <1>Server-Sent Events</1>. The job runs as a background task on the server — closing the connection will NOT cancel generation. Use <3>GET /urls/{video_id}</3> to fetch the result later.
generateTab.targetStageDescription: Stop generation at this stage. Recommended: HTML (full content, no render). Options: SCRIPT · TTS · WORDS · HTML · RENDER.
generateTab.responseNote: Content-Type: <1>text/event-stream</1>. Each line is prefixed with <3>data: </3> followed by a JSON object.

prompt.description: Natural language description of the content to generate.

contentType.description: Type of content. One of: VIDEO, SLIDES, QUIZ, STORYBOOK, FLASHCARDS, INTERACTIVE_GAME, PUZZLE_BOOK, SIMULATION, MAP_EXPLORATION, WORKSHEET, CODE_PLAYGROUND, TIMELINE, CONVERSATION.

ttsProvider.description: "standard" (Edge TTS, free) or "premium" (Google Cloud / Sarvam AI, 2x credits). Premium auto-routes: Indian languages → Sarvam, global → Google.

voiceId.description: Specific voice for premium TTS. Sarvam voices: "shubh", "priya", etc. Google voices: "en-US-Journey-F", etc. Use GET /tts/voices to list available options.

captionsEnabled.description: Whether to embed word-level caption data in the output.

targetAudience.description: Age/level description used to calibrate complexity. E.g. "Class 5 (Ages 10-11)", "Undergraduate".

targetDuration.description: Approximate output length. Options: "30 seconds", "1 minute", "2-3 minutes", "5 minutes", "10 minutes".

model.description: LLM model ID to use. Leave blank for the recommended default.

videoId.description: Custom stable identifier for this generation. Auto-generated if omitted. Use the same ID to resume.

pollingTab.cardDescription: Simpler alternative to SSE streaming. Start the generation (you can immediately close the HTTP connection — the server keeps running), then periodically call <1>GET /urls/{video_id}</1> until <3>html_url</3> is populated.
pollingTab.whenToUseTitle: When to use polling vs SSE
pollingTab.sseBullet: <0>SSE</0>: Best for UI dashboards that need live progress bars (stage %, messages).
pollingTab.pollingBullet: <0>Polling</0>: Best for backend scripts, cron jobs, or when you don't need real-time updates.
pollingTab.sameEndpointBullet: Both use the same endpoint — the difference is just whether you read the response stream.

1.label: POST /generate
1.description: Start the job. Include a stable video_id you control.

2.label: Close (or ignore) the SSE stream
2.description: Generation continues on the server regardless.

4.label: Use the returned URLs
4.description: Pass html_url + audio_url to your player.

historyTab.cardDescription: Returns the last N content generations for your institute, ordered newest-first. Maximum 50 per request.
historyTab.limitParamDescription: Number of items to return. Capped at 50.

statusTab.cardDescription: Returns the full status record for a generation including all available S3 URLs. Use this to check which stages have completed.

urlsTab.cardDescription: Returns the specific URLs needed to embed the content in a player. This is the most efficient endpoint for polling — smaller response than <1>/status</1>.
urlsTab.videoBullet: <0>VIDEO</0>: wait for <2>html_url != null AND audio_url != null</2>
urlsTab.slidesBullet: <0>SLIDES / QUIZ / etc.</0>: wait for <2>html_url != null</2> (no audio required)

htmlUrl.description: time_based_frame.json — array of {timestamp, html} objects. Feed to AIContentPlayer.

wordsUrl.description: narration.words.json — array of {word, start, end} for caption display.

avatarUrl.description: avatar_video.mp4 — talking-head avatar video (if generate_avatar was true).

regenerate.cardDescription: Ask the AI to rewrite the HTML of a specific slide/frame based on a prompt. Returns the new HTML for <1>preview only</1> — does not modify the timeline yet. Confirm by calling <3>/frame/update</3>.

timestamp.description: Time in seconds of the frame to edit. The nearest frame will be selected.

userPrompt.description: Instruction for how to change the frame. E.g. "Change background to dark blue and font to yellow."

update.cardDescription: Writes the confirmed HTML change into the stored timeline (time_based_frame.json). Call this after the user approves the preview from <1>/frame/regenerate</1>.

frameIndex.description: Zero-based index of the frame to update. Use the value returned by /frame/regenerate.

newHtml.description: Full HTML string to store. Typically the new_html from /frame/regenerate.

eventsTab.cardDescription: Every event in the <1>POST /generate</1> SSE stream is a JSON object on a <3>data: </3> line. There are four event types.

progress.note: Emitted at the start and end of each stage. The <1>files</1> field is populated as each stage completes.

completed.note: Final event. All requested stages are done.

info.note: Non-critical status messages (e.g. skipped stages on resume).

error.note: Sent when the pipeline fails. The <1>stage</1> field indicates which stage failed.

eventsTab.heartbeatNote: <0>Heartbeat</0> — every 60 s of silence the server sends an SSE comment line (<2>: heartbeat</2>) to keep proxies alive. These are not <4>data:</4> events and should be ignored by your parser.

forbidden.cause: API key is revoked or belongs to another institute.

notFound.cause: video_id does not exist in the database.

validationError.cause: Missing required field or invalid parameter value.

internalServerError.cause: Pipeline failure. Check the SSE error event for details.
